Please use one of our structured issue templates for submitting reports or proposals:

- **[Bug Report](https://github.com/mrxsierra/omni-agent-skills/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**: Report a bug in tooling, validation, or registry assets.
- **[Feature Request](https://github.com/mrxsierra/omni-agent-skills/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)**: Propose an enhancement or architectural improvement.
- **[Skill Proposal](https://github.com/mrxsierra/omni-agent-skills/issues/new?template=skill_proposal.yml)**: Propose a new skill runbook for `registry/skills/`.
- **[Discussions](https://github.com/mrxsierra/omni-agent-skills/discussions)**: Ask general questions or share workflows.
